script_text: Gemini, the swirling air currents bring sudden breakthroughs you can’t see coming. From Monday to Wednesday Mercury trines Jupiter in 10th House, boosting communication and opening career chances. Monday’s Mars square to your 6th House friction at work, while Wednesday shines Mercury’s trine peaks, perfect for promotions. Thursday Venus goes retrograde your 7th House, dissolving partnership illusions and prompting a financial review in the 2nd House. Friday‑Sunday Sun rests in your 4th House, airy thoughts into home comforts and sparking creative projects. Saturn sextiles the 5th House on Saturday for romance, while Mars opposes Mercury on Sunday, so keep talks light. Wednesday is your power day as Venus enters 5th House. Monday is your worst day as Mars squares your 6th House, sparking arguments and setbacks. Use Tuesday’s calm to draft an email; Mercury’s trine to Jupiter will amplify its impact. Follow for daily updates.
